intents.name: test-drive
examples: Can I book a test drive?
Is the test drive free?
intents.description: Book or inquire about test drives
intents.answer: Yes. Choose Book Test Drive in the menu, or call sales on +91 98250 22010. Bring a valid driving licence. Test drives run Mon–Sat, 10:00 AM–6:30 PM. Home test drives within 15 km of SG Highway can be arranged with advance booking.

intents.name: finance
examples: Do you offer car finance?
What documents are needed for a car loan?
intents.answer:
We work with HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis and Bajaj Finance. Down payment from about 10–20% depending on profile. Pre-approval often in 24–48 hours.

Documents needed: PAN, Aadhaar, 3 months’ salary slips (or ITR for self-employed), 6 months’ bank statements, and a cancelled cheque. Our desk helps complete the form.

intents.name: insurance
examples: Do you help with motor insurance?
intents.answer: Yes. We arrange comprehensive and zero-dep policies from leading insurers at the showroom. Multi-year options are available with new car delivery.

intents.name: exchange
examples: Do you accept exchange of my old car?
intents.answer: Yes. We evaluate most running cars free of cost. Bring RC, insurance and PUC. Exchange value is confirmed in writing and adjusted against the new car booking.

intents.name: booking-amount
examples: What is the booking amount for a new car?
intents.answer: Typically Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 51,000 depending on model. Booking is adjustable against the invoice. Cancellation terms are shared on the booking form.

intents.name: waiting-period
examples: How long is the waiting period for the Compact SUV?
intents.answer: Popular colours of the Compact SUV often deliver in 2–6 weeks. Exact wait depends on variant and colour — sales confirms against current allotment.

intents.name: colors
examples: What colours are available for the Midsize Sedan?
intents.answer: Common shades include Radiant Red, Lunar Silver, Meteoroid Grey, Pearl White and Golden Brown Metallic. Stock changes weekly — ask for today’s list.

intents.name: mileage
examples: What is the mileage of the Midsize Sedan petrol?
intents.answer: Claimed ARAI mileage for Midsize Sedan petrol MT is about 17.8 km/l (variant dependent). Real-world city figures typically range 12–15 km/l based on driving style.

intents.name: adas
examples: Is ADAS available on the Compact SUV?
intents.answer: Select Compact SUV variants offer ADAS features. Our product specialist will show which packs include lane watch, adaptive cruise and collision mitigation.

intents.name: warranty
examples: What warranty comes with a new car?
intents.answer: Standard manufacturer warranty is typically 3 years / 100,000 km (whichever earlier), with roadside assistance as per policy. Extended warranty packs are sold separately.

intents.name: service-schedule
examples: How do I book a periodic service?
Which service does my car need if I purchased it on a given date?
How much does a Midsize Sedan periodic service cost?
intents.description: Determine required service based on purchase date/km
intents.answer:
To determine your service schedule, please provide your purchase/delivery date and current odometer reading (km). We map this to the earliest of time or distance:

• ~1 month / 1,000 km: 1st free inspection/PDI follow-up (Fluid levels, tyre pressure, basic health check)
• ~6 months / 10,000 km: 1st periodic service (Engine oil + filter, inspection, top-ups)
• ~12 months / 20,000 km: 2nd periodic service (Oil & filter, air filter, brake & underbody inspection)
• ~18 months / 30,000 km: 3rd periodic service (Oil & filter, cabin/air filter, suspension & battery check)
• ~24 months / 40,000 km: 4th periodic/major check (Oil, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid)
• Every 6 months / 10,000 km thereafter: Ongoing periodic service
• Any time after accident/warning light: Repair/diagnosis visit

intents.name: spare-parts

intents.answer: Yes. Our workshop fits genuine OEM parts. Customers who insist on non-genuine parts must sign a written waiver — we recommend genuine only.

intents.name: eco-care
examples: How to save fuel?
Car care tips
intents.description: Tips for fuel efficiency and car care
intents.answer:
• Warm up gently; avoid high RPM for first 1–2 km.
• Smooth throttle and early upshifts save fuel.
• Keep tyre pressure at door-sticker PSI.
• Remove unused roof racks/heavy clutter.
• Use AC wisely (recirculate after cooling).
• Follow service schedule on time.
• Prefer recommended engine oil grade.
• Idle less than 30–60 seconds.
• Plan routes to avoid congestion.
• Check PUC, battery, coolant monthly.
• Wash with pH-neutral shampoo.
• For long trips, check tyres and carry tool kit.
For a personal eco check, we can offer a Book Service or callback.
